title: sign.rs: SignedData.version hardcoded V1 even when SignerInfo uses SubjectKeyIdentifier
description: In sign(), SignedData.version is hardcoded as CmsVersion::V1 (line 115). RFC 5652 §5.1 requires version=3 when any SignerInfo.sid uses SubjectKeyIdentifier. The cms crate's SignerIdentifier::from(&Certificate) prefers SubjectKeyIdentifier when the cert has the SKI extension (the common case with modern PKI certs). When that path is taken, SignerInfo.version is correctly set to V3 (lines 86-89), but SignedData.version remains V1 — a protocol violation. Strict receivers (or future validation in this crate) would reject such a SignedData. The fix is to derive SignedData.version from the signer identifiers, as is already done for SignerInfo.version.
